name: mirpur-drive
description: Mirpur Drive: a walkable and drivable 3D reconstruction of the Mirpur corridor along MRT Line 6, Dhaka, built from OpenStreetMap data.

scripts.data:bijoy: node tools/build-scene.mjs --in data/bijoy.osm.json --out public/scene-bijoy.json --stations "Agargaon,Bijoy Sarani,Farmgate" --metro-start "Agargaon" --metro-end "Farmgate" --extra-corridors manikmia,lakeroad,bijoysarani,agargaon
